description: Official, verified source registry for the NFL Lines & Strategy hub. Every value on the site is traceable to one of these sources. A value with no matching source is left blank and flagged on the Flagged for Review page.

sources.name: NFL Schedules
sources.provides: Fixtures, kickoff times, venues, broadcast, team records for the 2026 season
sources.notes: Fetched live 2026-11-13; Week 10 (Nov 12-16, 2026) fixtures and records present.

sources.name: NFL Injury Report
sources.provides: Player, position, injury, practice status (DNP/Limited/Full), game status (Out/Questionable/etc.) per team per week
sources.notes: Fetched live 2026-11-13; Week 10 2026 report present with per-player rows.

sources.name: 2026 NFL Rulebook
sources.provides: Official playing rules, game timing, overtime, halftime, roster/designation rules
sources.notes: Fetched live 2026-11-13; 2026 rule-change table and Rule 4 Game Timing present. PDF: https://static.www.nfl.com/image/upload/fl_attachment/league/tqivdkzt9mu6wdgsh1ku.pdf

sources.name: NFL Player Stats
sources.provides: Player statistical categories (passing, rushing, receiving, etc.) by season
sources.notes: Confirmed via official nfl.com/stats domain; category pages e.g. receiving stats.

sources.name: NFL Next Gen Stats
sources.provides: Real-time location, speed, acceleration, route/carry charts for every play
sources.notes: Confirmed live official domain; play-level tracking data source.

sources.name: NFL Standings
sources.provides: Division/conference/league standings: W-L-T, point differential, division record
sources.notes: Fetched live 2026-11-13; 2026 division standings present.

sources.name: NFL roster/IR rule update
sources.provides: Injured-reserve return eligibility (four games), practice-squad size, elevation limits
sources.notes: Official NFL.com news; IR/practice-squad rule facts. Cross-check current roster limits against S3 rulebook.

sources.name: Colorado Division of Gaming - Sports Betting Regulations
sources.publisher: Colorado Department of Revenue, Division of Gaming
sources.provides: Definitions of proposition (prop) bet, parlay, straight bet, and required wager records
sources.notes: Official state regulator rulebook; authoritative definitions for bet mechanics.

sources.name: New York State Gaming Commission - Sports Wagering
sources.provides: Proposition wager definitions, wagering-menu control, league restriction/exclusion authority
sources.notes: Official state regulator page; confirms prop-bet definition and menu control.

sources.name: Nevada Gaming Control Board - Regulations 22.060/22.090/22.150
sources.provides: Acceptance of wagers, parlay-card wagers, house-rules approval and recordkeeping
sources.notes: Official Nevada regulator regulation (effective 2026-02-28); parlay-card and house-rule authority.

sources.name: nflverse schedules — results and margins
sources.provides: Final scores, home/away results and margins per game (games.csv).
sources.notes: Primary outcome source for the Lines Lab model; SHA-256 pinned in nfl/data/provenance.json.

sources.name: nflverse schedules — division-game flag
sources.provides: Published per-game division-game flag (games.csv).
sources.notes: Used as a model signal exactly as published; never inferred.

sources.name: nflverse schedules — rest days
sources.provides: Published home_rest / away_rest days per game (games.csv).
sources.notes: Rest-difference signal uses the published columns only.

sources.name: nflverse schedules — venue and weather fields
sources.provides: Roof, surface, temperature and wind columns per game (games.csv).
sources.notes: Dome/roof signal; weather columns blank where the source is blank.

sources.name: nflverse spread_line + ESPN current-week odds
sources.provides: Closing spread_line per game (games.csv) and current-week odds from the ESPN scoreboard API.
sources.notes: Single un-timestamped price per game (GAP-1): presence is published, no ROI or edge is claimed. ESPN: https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/football/nfl/scoreboard

sources.name: nflverse schedules + weekly player stats
sources.provides: Game results joined to weekly player statistics for prop evaluation.
sources.notes: Player stats: https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/tag/player_stats

sources.name: nflverse weekly player statistics
sources.provides: stats_player_week_YYYY.csv per season (2019 published as player_stats_2019.csv).
sources.notes: Prop base rates and outcomes; 2019/2026 asset names recorded in nfl/data/provenance.json.

sources.name: nflverse depth charts — positional rank per snapshot
sources.provides: Depth-chart rows with pos_rank per team/position and chart date.
sources.notes: 1st–4th-string tiers; each board row carries its chart snapshot date (depthSnapshotUTC).

sources.id: nflverse injuries + depth charts + snap counts
sources.name: nflverse injuries, depth charts and snap counts
sources.provides: Weekly injury reports, depth charts and snap counts for availability and replacement tracking.
sources.notes: Also https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/tag/depth_charts and https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/tag/snap_counts. Official report status is kept separate from inferred availability.

sources.name: nflverse injuries 2025 (injuries_2025.csv)
sources.provides: Weekly official injury-report rows for the 2025 season.
sources.notes: Fetched and hashed by CI; see nfl/data/provenance.json.

sources.name: nflverse schedules (games.csv)
sources.provides: Master schedule/results table 1999–2026.
sources.notes: Fetched and hashed by CI; see nfl/data/provenance.json.

sources.name: ESPN NFL scoreboard API
sources.provides: Independent final-score cross-check and current-week odds sample.
sources.notes: Cross-check: 2,776 of 2,776 sampled completed games match nflverse exactly (0 differ, 0 unmatched).

sources.name: NFL Schedules (URL reference in Lines Lab data)
sources.provides: Official schedule portal referenced by Lines Lab question/audit rows.
sources.notes: Same portal as S1; distinct id because Lines Lab data files cite the URL directly.

sources.name: Lines Lab provenance manifest — internal verification record (nfl/data/provenance.json)
sources.provides: SHA-256 hash, byte size, HTTP status and source URL for every file the Lines Lab fetcher downloads.
sources.notes: Derivative verification record compiled by CI from official/nflverse fetches; each manifest row carries its own official source URL.
